capitulation._verdict: VALIDATED 2026-06-11 on 2019-2026 live data: 6 episodes (2020-03-09/19, 2022-03-08, 2024-04-22, 2024-07-19, 2024-08-05), fwd 20d median +5.75% vs baseline +2.22%, 60d +9.80% vs +5.04%, 60d hit 83%. n=6: no statistical significance claimed; justified by DCA payoff asymmetry (false alarm = buy a few days early; miss = skip the best windows).

overheat._verdict: RETIRED 2026-06-11 after retrial at relaxed thresholds (90/85/70): 2 episodes in 7y (2021-06-11, 2026-06-01), the only measurable one went +3.49% at 20d (wrong direction), hit 0%. Structural cause: bottoms are events (panic co-occurs intraday), tops are processes (euphoria disperses; tops form by rotation). Tier-2 OVERHEAT regime band retained as temperature description; only the Tier-3 actionable alert is deleted. 2026-06-01 single hit filed as anecdote, not instrument.
